Dealer Management Portal

Client

Leading firm in automotive sector

Sector

Automotive

Technology

Flutter (iOS, Android)

❌ Pain Point

A leading firm in automotive sector had to build a unified digital interface for its dealer network limiting real-time communication, order tracking, shipment coordination, and post-sales management. Absence of an integrated system led to fragmented processes and reduced efficiency.

✅ Solution

Etere Studio contributed to deliver a custom-built supply chain management platform to unify client's dealer operations with real-time visibility and control. Integrated communication layer for real-time inventory tracking across dealer network Optimized order management workflows for end-to-end supply chain orchestration Enterprise-grade performance, with secure data handling aligned to client's compliance and scalability standards

Highlights

  • Integrated communication layer for real-time inventory tracking across dealer network
  • Optimized order management workflows for end-to-end supply chain orchestration
  • Enterprise-grade performance, with secure data handling aligned to client's compliance and scalability standards
